rv.q: Still, there are laughs to be had in this uneven comedy, especially in the outrageous orgy scene, which involves various permutations of the couples in the frenzied act of humping like … well, like rabbits.
That could be the reason why I found the play, presented as part of the International Fringe Encore Series, smarmy and excruciating.

cn.t: Critics find this sex comedy about marriage and money largely underwhelming, with one dismissing it as "smarmy and excruciating" with a clunky script, while another deems it only "mildly amusing."
